# Tools

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "fetch_url", "description": "Fetch a web page and return its text content.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"url": {"type": "string", "description": "The full URL to fetch."}}, "required": ["url"]}}}
</tools>

For each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags:
<tool_call>
{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}
</tool_call>

steps.content: Both sellers, Brackmoor Sound and Ottervale Audio, offer the Quellwyn Stillwave H2 headphones at the same price, with identical product features and descriptions. However, Brackmoor Sound is noted as an authorized Quellwyn dealer and offers a full manufacturer warranty, which might provide additional peace of mind. Ottervale Audio does not specify if they are authorized, but they also offer a 1-year limited warranty. If you prioritize official dealer status and manufacturer warranty, choose Brackmoor Sound. If you are less concerned about the warranty and prefer to shop from a different seller, Ottervale Audio is a viable option.
